media_assets_pending_upload_chk.name: media_assets_pending_upload_chk

media_assets_ready_chk.name: media_assets_ready_chk
media_assets_ready_chk.value:
"media_assets"."status" <> 'READY' or (
        "media_assets"."ready_at" is not null
        and "media_assets"."verified_content_type" is not null
        and "media_assets"."verified_size_bytes" is not null
        and "media_assets"."deleted_at" is null
      )

media_assets_deleted_chk.name: media_assets_deleted_chk
media_assets_deleted_chk.value:
"media_assets"."status" <> 'DELETED' or (
        "media_assets"."delete_requested_at" is not null
        and "media_assets"."deleted_at" is not null
        and "media_assets"."attached_at" is null
      )
